title: Apollo and MGM sides of 1948
summary: The Apollo sides 'Cry Buttercup, Cry' and 'Restless' are a mystery; the MGM pair she sang nowhere else.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: Okay. The next session -- well I guess the next two sessions -- we'll put them together -- are from the year 1948 with no exact recording date listed.

And, in fact, in one case it may not be a recording date, but merely a date of issue. One if a pair of sides for Apollo -- 'Cry Buttercup, Cry' and 'Restless.' And according to the discographies, that there're no details about the personnel on those.
Right. Well I don't know who the guys were either offhand. I can't remember. But this Apollo label -- I was approached in --
Of course, Restless is an old song, but 'Cry Buttercup Cry' was a new song which someone had
S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943

written, and submitted it to Apollo and I recorded it. I've never heard this. And that might've been somebody's date -- you know, some musician's date and they had to fill in a couple of vocals, or something like that. So they asked me to do it. I really don't recall too much about it.
Okay. So that's something of a mystery then.
The other pair of sides were issued on the MGM label in '48. And the titles are "Behaving Myself For You" and "The Story of Our Love Affair," which sound a little familiar, don't they?

Well, I noticed that they were issued by MGM. And what I'm thinking must've happened here is, that they might've picked them up from Beacon from the previous album that I made. Because I certainly would not have recorded these things a second time.
S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943
You didn't think they merited it?
No. I never sang them any place else except on those albums.
